reviewPolicy.sourcePolicy: Use the Segment 143 Element 229/230/231 clauses. Test only the explicit N branch; do not infer that I/E makes Tax Type or Tax Amount required.
reviewPolicy.dataPolicy: Field-level mutation designs only. Complete Product Code Segment context, unaffected fields, delimiters, and operation validity require authorized Test review.
reviewPolicy.baselinePolicy: References SEG143-R-006 and its existing placeholder chain; no official Test baseline record is modified.
reviewPolicy.promotionGate: Authorized Test review must approve field-level encoding, N-condition fixture, serialization semantics, and expected structural validation before promotion or execution.

requirementReferences.title: Inclusive/Exclusive flag values: I (inclusive to the product amount), E (exclusive), N (this tax not applicable; tax type and amount fields are skipped)
When Inclusive/Exclusive for Tax 3 (Element 229) is N, Tax Type 3 (Element 230) and Tax Amount 3 (Element 231) are omitted

sourceEvidence.quote: If this tax amount value is “N”, both tax type and amount should be skipped.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: Element 229 is a one-character I/E/N flag. For N, the source says both associated type and amount are skipped.

sourceEvidence.quote: Processing Rules: If the Inclusive/Exclusive flag is “N”, this field is omitted.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: Tax Type 3 (Element 230) is omitted when the flag is N.

sourceEvidence.quote: Processing Rules: If the Inclusive/Exclusive flag is “N”, this field should be omitted.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: Tax Amount 3 (Element 231) should be omitted when the flag is N.

testScenarios.intent: For a reviewed-valid Segment 143 Product Code context with Inclusive/Exclusive for Tax 3 set to N, verify Tax Type 3 and Tax Amount 3 are both omitted; independently mutate each associated field to be present.

testCases.assertion: With Element 229 = N, Elements 230 and 231 are both omitted.
With Element 229 = N, Element 230 is present while Element 231 is omitted.
With Element 229 = N, Element 231 is present while Element 230 is omitted.
